items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying, 2:2 Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father’s house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.
items.claim: The text says the LORD told Moses and Aaron that every Israelite must camp by his own standard, with the banner of his father's house, at a distance around the tabernacle of the congregation. (Passes 1 and 2 agreed on this item; pass 3 was empty. Identifying the passage as Numbers 2:1-2 in the KJV is model-prior and is not stated in the document.)
items.actor: the LORD (speaking to Moses and Aaron)
items.object: children of Israel camping by standard and father's-house ensign around the tabernacle
items.place: around the tabernacle of the congregation
items.mechanism: each man camps by his tribal standard and the ensign of his father's house, far off about the tabernacle
